ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (approx. 80%) with localized high-intensity regions (approx. 20%) primarily on the right lobe and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large irregular high-intensity contiguous region on the right lobe extending from the central-medial area to the upper-lateral margin. Discrete high-intensity spots localized at the distal extremities of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch; vertex angle approximately 70 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary; high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels, with highest density concentrated on the lateral thirds of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep; outer trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups at the left distal tip; sparse circular white markings on the right lobe tip margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity mottled region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular erosion of the left lobe's distal tip margin, suggesting significant tissue irregularity or scarring compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark vertical linear streak near the base of the right lobe leading toward the median notch.
